summary: Custom action plugins are enabled by placing them in an action_plugins directory next to the play, inside a role, or in an action plugin path configured in ansible.cfg.
questions: Where do I put a custom action plugin so Ansible finds it?
Can a role ship its own action plugin?
How do I configure extra action plugin directories?

answer_card.title: Enabling a custom action plugin
answer_card.answer_md:
Put it in one of these places:
- an `action_plugins` directory next to your play
- inside a role
- an action plugin directory configured in `ansible.cfg`
